correctness.rationale: Exact induction on complete odd-factorial blocks proves valuation t+1+parity; products of odd numbers of blocks extend this to a sharp distance law. The normalized four index residue-class maps are isometries of Z_2, hence surjective by their induced finite-level permutations. The image, Haar measure, fibers and least periods follow; the included exact checker corroborates k<=15.
